quote: **`ods-cli`** — main Bash CLI for managing the stack; keep changes narrow and follow `docs/ODS_CLI_DECOMPOSITION.md` for behavior-preserving split work
statement: In ods/ods-cli, changes should stay narrow and any split of the CLI must follow ods/docs/ODS_CLI_DECOMPOSITION.md and preserve behavior.

quote: The installer is modular with a strict separation: `installers/lib/` contains pure functions (no side effects), `installers/phases/` contain sequential steps that execute on `source`.
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*.sh, files must only define pure functions (no side effects at source time); executable install steps belong in ods/installers/phases/*.sh.

quote: Every module has a standardized header (Purpose, Expects, Provides, Modder notes).
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*.sh and ods/installers/phases/*.sh, every module must start with the standardized header containing Purpose, Expects, Provides and Modder notes fields.

quote: The orchestrator (`install-core.sh`) sets `INSTALL_PHASE` before each phase for error reporting.
statement: In ods/install-core.sh, the orchestrator must set INSTALL_PHASE before sourcing each phase file.

quote: Every service is an extension under `extensions/services/<name>/`. Each has a `manifest.yaml` defining metadata (id, port, health endpoint, container name, aliases, category, GPU backends, feature flags).
statement: In ods/extensions/services/<name>/, every service directory must contain a manifest.yaml defining its metadata.

quote: Core services (llama-server, open-webui, dashboard, dashboard-api) only have manifests — their compose lives in `docker-compose.base.yml`.
statement: In ods/extensions/services/{llama-server,open-webui,dashboard,dashboard-api}/, core services must have only a manifest.yaml and no compose.yaml; their compose definitions live in ods/docker-compose.base.yml.

quote: Services bind to `127.0.0.1` by default for security.
statement: In ods/docker-compose*.yml and extension compose.yaml files, published service ports must bind to 127.0.0.1 by default.

quote: **Shell**: Bash with `set -euo pipefail`.
statement: In all Bash scripts, the script must enable `set -euo pipefail`.

quote: Use `shellcheck` for linting.
statement: In all shell scripts, code must pass shellcheck.

quote: POSIX-compatible constructs preferred for macOS portability (avoid GNU-only date/grep).
statement: In shell scripts, code should use POSIX-compatible constructs and must avoid GNU-only flags of date and grep for macOS portability.

quote: **Python**: Standard formatting, consistent with existing file style.
statement: In Python files, code should use standard formatting consistent with the existing file's style.

quote: FastAPI for APIs. Pytest for tests.
statement: In Python services, HTTP APIs must be built with FastAPI.

quote: FastAPI for APIs. Pytest for tests.
statement: In Python test files, tests must be written for pytest.

quote: **JavaScript/React**: ESLint with flat config. Vite for bundling. Tailwind CSS for styling.
statement: In ods/extensions/services/dashboard/src/**, React components must be styled with Tailwind CSS utility classes.

quote: **No broad or silent catches.** Never `except Exception: pass` or `except Exception: return None`.
statement: In all Python code, code must not use broad or silent catches such as `except Exception: pass` or `except Exception: return None`.

quote: No retry/backoff loops.
statement: In all code, code must not implement retry/backoff loops.

quote: No fallback chains.
statement: In all code, code must not implement fallback chains that try alternative paths after a failure.

quote: Health checks, network calls, and file I/O may catch *specific* exception types (e.g., `asyncio.TimeoutError`, `aiohttp.ClientConnectorError`) when each maps to a distinct, meaningful status.
statement: In Python I/O boundary code (health checks, network calls, file I/O), exception handlers must catch only specific exception types (e.g. asyncio.TimeoutError, aiohttp.ClientConnectorError), each mapping to a distinct status.

quote: **Internal functions: let exceptions propagate.** The default is zero error handling — errors crash visibly with a full stack trace.
statement: In internal (non-boundary) functions, code must not add try/except error handling; exceptions must propagate.

quote: **Bash: `set -euo pipefail` everywhere.** Errors kill the process. Use `trap` handlers for context (see `install-core.sh`).
statement: In Bash scripts, code should use `trap` handlers to add error context (as in ods/install-core.sh).

quote: If you must tolerate a failure, log it: `some_command || warn "failed (non-fatal)"`.
statement: In Bash scripts, a tolerated command failure must be logged with `|| warn "..."` rather than silently ignored.

quote: Do not add new `|| true` or `2>/dev/null` without a comment explaining why the failure is safe to ignore
statement: In Bash scripts, new code must not use `|| true` or `2>/dev/null` without an adjacent comment explaining why the failure is safe to ignore.

quote: **Python boundaries: raise, don't swallow.** FastAPI routers validate input and `raise HTTPException`.
statement: In FastAPI routers (ods/extensions/services/dashboard-api/routers/*.py), handlers must validate input and signal errors by raising HTTPException.

quote: Never return `None` to signal an error.
statement: In Python code, functions must not return None to signal an error.

quote: **Tests: let assertions fail visibly.** Never catch exceptions in tests to avoid failure.
statement: In test files, tests must not catch exceptions to avoid failure.

quote: One function, one job. Flatten deep nesting with early returns.
statement: In all code, functions should flatten deep nesting using early returns.

quote: No premature abstraction — wait for 3+ use cases.
statement: In all code, abstractions should not be introduced until there are 3 or more use cases.

quote: Thresholds: functions > 30 lines, nesting > 3 levels, files > 500 lines → consider splitting.
statement: In all code, functions should stay at or under 30 lines, nesting at or under 3 levels, and files at or under 500 lines; larger ones should be split.

quote: Default to pure for business logic, validation, data mapping (same inputs → same output, no side effects).
statement: In business logic, validation and data-mapping code, functions should be pure (no side effects).
scope: business logic / validation / data mapping functions

quote: Push I/O to boundaries. Follow **functional core, imperative shell** — `installers/lib/` is the pure core, `installers/phases/` is the imperative shell.
statement: In the installer, I/O and side effects must live in ods/installers/phases/*.sh (imperative shell), not in ods/installers/lib/*.sh (pure core).

quote: If purity adds excessive wiring, prefer a simple impure function with a comment.
statement: In code where purity adds excessive wiring, a simple impure function should be used and marked with an explanatory comment.

quote: **OCP**: Extend via config/data (extension manifests, backend JSON files), not code modification.
statement: In the stack, new services/backends should be added via config/data (extension manifests, config/backends/*.json) rather than by modifying code.

quote: **DIP**: Inject dependencies via env vars (Bash) and `Depends()` (FastAPI). Don't hardcode.
statement: In FastAPI handlers, dependencies must be injected with Depends(), and in Bash scripts via environment variables, rather than hardcoded.

quote: Installer libraries in `installers/lib/` are pure functions (no side effects); `lib/service-registry.sh` loads service manifests and port metadata; phases in `installers/phases/` execute sequentially.
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*.sh, files must contain only pure functions with no side effects.

quote: All services bind to `127.0.0.1` (localhost only). Canonical port assignments live in `config/ports.json`.
statement: In compose files, service ports must bind to 127.0.0.1, and port assignments must come from ods/config/ports.json.

quote: The manifest schema is enforced by `extensions/schema/service-manifest.v1.json`.
statement: In ods/extensions/services/*/manifest.yaml, manifests must conform to ods/extensions/schema/service-manifest.v1.json.

quote: **Let It Crash**: No broad catches, no silent swallowing. Errors propagate visibly. Bash uses `set -euo pipefail` everywhere.
statement: In all code, code must not use broad catches or silently swallow errors; Bash scripts must use `set -euo pipefail`.

quote: New tests must run in CI: add them to a workflow step or to `ods/tests/ci-suite.txt`. ... A check fails when a test under `ods/tests` or `ods/extensions/services/*/tests` is not executed by CI and not recorded, with a reason, in `ods/tests/ci-not-run.txt`.
statement: In ods/tests/** and ods/extensions/services/*/tests/**, every test file must be executed by a CI workflow or listed in ods/tests/ci-suite.txt, or recorded with a reason in ods/tests/ci-not-run.txt.

quote: The *Python Type Check* jobs fail on new mypy errors in dashboard-api, token-spy, privacy-shield and `ods/scripts`. Existing errors are recorded in `.github/mypy-baseline.json`
statement: In ods/extensions/services/{dashboard-api,token-spy,privacy-shield}/ and ods/scripts/*.py, code must not introduce mypy errors beyond .github/mypy-baseline.json.

quote: Retain upstream copyright and license notices.
statement: In copied or vendored files, upstream copyright and license notices must be retained.

quote: **Error messages that actually help** — "what went wrong" and "what to do about it." No stack traces. No silent failures.
statement: In installer code, user-facing error messages should state what went wrong and what to do, without stack traces or silent failures.

quote: **POSIX compliance** — BSD sed is not GNU sed. BSD date is not GNU date. If it runs on macOS, don't use GNU-only flags. Use `_sed_i` and `_now_ms`.
statement: In shell scripts that run on macOS, code must not use GNU-only sed/date flags and must use the `_sed_i` and `_now_ms` helpers for in-place sed and millisecond timestamps.

quote: **Bash compatibility** — macOS ships Bash 3.2. No associative arrays unless you guard for Bash 4+.
statement: In Bash scripts, code must not use associative arrays (declare -A) unless guarded by a Bash 4+ version check.

quote: **Path handling** — Windows vs Unix, spaces, symlinks, external drives. Use `path-utils.sh`.
statement: In shell scripts, path handling should use the helpers in ods/installers/lib/path-utils.sh.

quote: **Code that was never run.** If your function is referenced but never defined, or your shell variable won't expand in exec form — we'll catch it.
statement: In all code, referenced functions must be defined, and shell variables must not be used in Dockerfile/compose exec-form commands where they will not expand.
scope: all source files, Dockerfiles and compose files

quote: **Tests for imaginary features.** A test suite that skip()'s every assertion because the feature doesn't exist yet is worse than no tests
statement: In test files, tests must not skip() assertions for features that do not exist yet.

quote: **Bash** — `set -euo pipefail` at the top. Quote your variables. Run `shellcheck`.
statement: In Bash scripts, `set -euo pipefail` must appear at the top of the file.

quote: Quote your variables.
statement: In Bash scripts, variable expansions must be quoted.

quote: **Python** — match whatever the file already does. Don't reformat code you didn't change.
statement: In Python files, code must match the file's existing style and must not reformat unchanged code.

quote: **YAML/JSON** — stable keys, no tabs, don't get creative.
statement: In YAML and JSON files, keys must be stable and tabs must not be used.

quote: **Libraries are safe to source.** Every file in `lib/` defines functions only — no side effects. ... They must be sourced in order because later libraries depend on earlier ones
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*.sh, each file must only define functions and constants with no top-level side effects.

quote: **Phases execute immediately when sourced.** Each file in `phases/` is a self-contained install step that runs its logic the moment `source` evaluates it.
statement: In ods/installers/phases/*.sh, each phase file must run its step's logic at top level when sourced.

quote: Plain mode never clears the screen, rings the terminal bell, or emits cursor-motion animation.
statement: In installer UI code, plain mode must not clear the screen, ring the terminal bell, or emit cursor-motion escape sequences.

quote: Every module uses a standardized header: #!/bin/bash / # ODS Installer — <Module Name> / # Part of: installers/lib/ / # Purpose: / # Expects: / # Provides: / # Modder notes:
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*.sh and ods/installers/phases/*.sh, each file must begin with the standard header block (`#!/bin/bash`, `ODS Installer — <Module Name>`, Part of, Purpose, Expects, Provides, Modder notes).

quote: **Add a new phase** | `installers/phases/` | Create a numbered `.sh` file with the standard header, then add a `source` line in `install-core.sh` in the right order
statement: In ods/installers/phases/, new phases must be numbered `NN-name.sh` files with the standard header and must be sourced from ods/install-core.sh in order.

quote: OpenCode must use `LITELLM_KEY` when it reaches the model through LiteLLM, which enforces auth, while direct llama-server paths keep `no-key`
statement: In OpenCode config writers, configs routed through LiteLLM must use LITELLM_KEY, while direct llama-server paths use `no-key`.
scope: OpenCode config writers (phases/07-devtools.sh, macOS/Windows installers, upgrade scripts)

quote: the LiteLLM config for a Windows `llama-server.exe` must keep `extra_body.chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking: false` and name the server key only by reference (`os.environ/LLAMA_SERVER_API_KEY`) in every writer
statement: In every writer of config/litellm/local.yaml, the config must set extra_body.chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking: false and reference the key only as os.environ/LLAMA_SERVER_API_KEY, never as a literal.

quote: Installer libraries in `installers/lib/*` should define functions and constants only.
statement: In ods/installers/lib/*, files should define only functions and constants.

quote: A phase should mutate only the surfaces it owns.
statement: In ods/installers/phases/*.sh, each phase should mutate only the surfaces it owns per the phase contract table.

quote: UI presentation must not change phase exit codes, error propagation, interrupt behavior, structured progress records, or log evidence.
statement: In installer UI code, presentation logic must not change phase exit codes, error propagation, interrupt behavior, ODS_PROGRESS records, or logs.

quote: Non-TTY, CI, GUI, and `NO_COLOR` paths must be deterministic and free of screen clearing, terminal bells, and cursor-motion animation.
statement: In installer output code, non-TTY, CI, GUI and NO_COLOR paths must not emit screen clearing, terminal bells or cursor-motion animation.

quote: keep the public command syntax unchanged;
statement: In ods/ods-cli decomposition changes, the public command syntax must remain unchanged.

quote: Compose bind mounts use shared `:z` labels so enforcing SELinux can relabel ODS repo/data paths for containers. If you add custom bind mounts on SELinux systems, include `:z` as well.
statement: In compose files, bind mounts should carry the `:z` SELinux label.

quote: Required root field: - `schema_version: ods.services.v1`
statement: In ods/extensions/services/*/manifest.yaml, the root must set schema_version: ods.services.v1.

quote: Service section: - required: `id`, `name`, `port`, `health`
statement: In ods/extensions/services/*/manifest.yaml, the service section must define id, name, port and health.

quote: Feature section (optional list): - required per feature: `id`, `name`, `description`, `icon`, `category`, `requirements`, `priority`
statement: In ods/extensions/services/*/manifest.yaml, each feature entry must define id, name, description, icon, category, requirements and priority.

quote: LLM section (optional under `service`, required for LLM consumers):
statement: In ods/extensions/services/*/manifest.yaml, services that consume an LLM must declare a service.llm block (consumes, route, pinning, probe).

quote: the `# >>> shared compose policy >>>` block, kept byte-identical in both files (`extensions/services/dashboard-api/tests/test_compose_policy_parity.py`)
statement: In ods/extensions/services/dashboard-api/routers/extensions.py and ods/scripts/resolve-compose-stack.sh, the `# >>> shared compose policy >>>` block must be byte-identical.

quote: Keep extension files ASCII and small; one service per directory is preferred.
statement: In ods/extensions/services/*/, extension files should be ASCII and small, with one service per directory.

quote: **Scripts that load `.env`:** Source `lib/safe-env.sh` and use `load_env_file "<path>"`; do not use `eval` or `export $(grep ... .env | xargs)` (injection risk).
statement: In shell scripts that load .env files, code must source lib/safe-env.sh and call load_env_file, and must not use eval or `export $(grep ... .env | xargs)`.

quote: Apps that speak the OpenAI protocol should use the gateway alias by default and avoid persisting GGUF filenames, catalog ids, or other concrete model names.
statement: In extension app config, OpenAI-protocol apps should target the gateway alias (http://litellm:4000/v1, model ods/current) and should not persist GGUF filenames, catalog ids or concrete model names.

quote: Do not persist GGUF filenames, llama-server model names, or catalog ids in your app config. The gateway alias is the app contract.
statement: In extension app config, code must not persist GGUF filenames, llama-server model names or catalog ids; it must use the ods/current gateway alias.

quote: Direct routes are allowed, but they are not the default. A direct route must declare `pinning: dynamic` and a probe that proves the app refreshed to the new model after a swap.
statement: In manifest.yaml, an llm block with route: direct must declare pinning: dynamic and a probe.

quote: A service referenced by `depends_on` must exist in every resolved file set that includes that dependency.
statement: In compose files, every service named in depends_on must be defined in every resolved compose file set that includes the dependent service.

quote: Host ports must be declared through the port contract where applicable.
statement: In compose files, host ports must be declared through the port contract (ods/config/ports.json and manifest port env vars) rather than hardcoded.

quote: Hardware overlays should change runtime flags, devices, images, or build targets only for the relevant backend.
statement: In GPU overlay compose files (docker-compose.{amd,nvidia,apple}.yml, compose.{amd,nvidia}.yaml), overlays should only change runtime flags, devices, images or build targets for their backend.

quote: Internal service-to-service traffic should use container DNS and internal ports.
statement: In service config, service-to-service traffic should use container DNS names and internal ports, not host ports.

quote: Host-facing port defaults belong in `config/ports.json` and service manifests.
statement: In the repo, host-facing port defaults must be defined in ods/config/ports.json and service manifests.

quote: "no-unused-vars": ["warn", { argsIgnorePattern: "^_" }]
statement: In ods/extensions/services/dashboard/**/*.{js,jsx}, code should not have unused variables; unused function arguments are allowed only when prefixed with `_`.

quote: ruff check ods/ --select E,F,W (E)
statement: In ods/**/*.py, code must pass ruff pycodestyle error rules (E).

quote: ruff check ods/ --select E,F,W (F)
statement: In ods/**/*.py, code must pass ruff Pyflakes rules (F): no unused imports/variables, undefined names, etc.

quote: ruff check ods/ --select E,F,W (W)
statement: In ods/**/*.py, code must pass ruff pycodestyle warning rules (W).

quote: --ignore E501
statement: In ods/**/*.py, line length (E501) is not enforced.

quote: --ignore E701
statement: In ods/**/*.py, multiple statements on one line after a colon (E701) are not flagged.

quote: --ignore E731
statement: In ods/**/*.py, assigning a lambda expression to a name (E731) is not flagged.

quote: --ignore E741
statement: In ods/**/*.py, ambiguous variable names such as l, O, I (E741) are not flagged.

quote: --ignore E402
statement: In ods/**/*.py, module-level imports not at the top of the file (E402) are not flagged.

quote: ruff check ods/ --target-version py39 --select E9
statement: In ods/**/*.py, code must parse under Python 3.9 syntax (no 3.10+/3.12-only syntax such as backslashes inside f-string expressions).

quote: mypy $SOURCES --check-untyped-defs
statement: In dashboard-api, token-spy, privacy-shield and ods/scripts/*.py, mypy also type-checks the bodies of unannotated functions.

quote: mypy $SOURCES --no-strict-optional
statement: In mypy-checked Python targets, strict Optional/None checking is turned off.

quote: mypy $SOURCES --ignore-missing-imports
statement: In mypy-checked Python targets, errors for imports without type stubs or that cannot be resolved are suppressed.

quote: shellcheck --exclude=SC1091,SC2034 --severity=error (ods/**/*.sh, ods/ods-cli, ods/bin/ods-pixel-approve)
statement: In ods/**/*.sh, ods/ods-cli and ods/bin/ods-pixel-approve, code must have no error-severity ShellCheck findings.

quote: --exclude=SC1091  exclude "can't follow sourced files"
statement: In ods shell scripts, ShellCheck SC1091 (not following sourced files) is disabled.

quote: --exclude=SC2034  exclude "unused variables" (many are used by sourced files)
statement: In ods shell scripts, ShellCheck SC2034 (unused variables) is disabled because variables are consumed by sourced files.

quote: Regression guard - no http://localhost in shell scripts: grep -nE 'curl[^|]*http://localhost:' ... use 127.0.0.1 (IPv6 ::1 resolution can hang on macOS)
statement: In ods/**/*.sh and *.bash (except scripts/demo-offline.sh and tests/test-extension-audit.sh), curl calls must not target http://localhost:; they must use 127.0.0.1.

quote: shellcheck -x -S warning "${files[@]}" (git ls-files '*.sh' ':!:vendor/pixel/**')
statement: In ods/**/*.sh (excluding vendor/pixel), code must have no ShellCheck findings at warning severity or above, following sourced files (-x).

quote: bash -n "$f"
statement: In ods/**/*.sh (excluding vendor/pixel), every script must pass `bash -n` syntax checking.

quote: ExcludeRules = @('PSAvoidUsingWriteHost' ...)
statement: In PowerShell installer scripts, use of Write-Host is permitted (PSAvoidUsingWriteHost disabled).

quote: ExcludeRules = @(... 'PSAvoidUsingEmptyCatchBlock' ...)
statement: In PowerShell installer scripts, empty catch blocks are not flagged (PSAvoidUsingEmptyCatchBlock disabled).

quote: ExcludeRules = @(... 'PSUseBOMForUnicodeEncodedFile' ...)
statement: In PowerShell scripts, a BOM is not required for Unicode-encoded files (PSUseBOMForUnicodeEncodedFile disabled).

quote: ExcludeRules = @(... 'PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions' ...)
statement: In PowerShell scripts, state-changing functions are not required to support ShouldProcess (PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions disabled).

quote: ExcludeRules = @(... 'PSUseApprovedVerbs' ...)
statement: In PowerShell scripts, function names are not required to use approved verbs (PSUseApprovedVerbs disabled).

quote: ExcludeRules = @(... 'PSUseDeclaredVarsMoreThanAssignments' ...)
statement: In PowerShell scripts, variables assigned but not used are not flagged (PSUseDeclaredVarsMoreThanAssignments disabled).

quote: ExcludeRules = @(... 'PSUseSingularNouns')
statement: In PowerShell scripts, function nouns are not required to be singular (PSUseSingularNouns disabled).

quote: PSAvoidUsingConvertToSecureStringWithPlainText = @{ Enable = $true }
statement: In PowerShell scripts, code must not call ConvertTo-SecureString with -AsPlainText.

quote: New source access belongs behind a projection broker, writes belong behind a separate actuator, and machine work belongs behind a named Operations action or an exact break-glass proposal.
statement: In ods/vendor/pixel, new source reads must go through a projection broker, writes through a separate actuator, and machine work through a named Operations action.

quote: Do not add a generic Frontier prompt, file, repository, URL, message, or log forwarder.
statement: In ods/vendor/pixel, code must not add a generic Frontier forwarder for prompts, files, repositories, URLs, messages or logs.

quote: A bug fix must add a regression that fails before the fix.
statement: In ods/vendor/pixel, every bug fix must add a regression test that fails before the fix.

quote: Edit release pins only in `RELEASE-MANIFEST.json` and compatibility state only in `OPENCLAW-COMPATIBILITY.json`, then run: node scripts/generate-release-files.mjs --write
statement: In ods/vendor/pixel, release pins must be edited only in RELEASE-MANIFEST.json and compatibility state only in OPENCLAW-COMPATIBILITY.json; derived files are generated by scripts/generate-release-files.mjs.

quote: Use synthetic fixtures for tests and sanitized, identity-bound summaries for release evidence.
statement: In ods/vendor/pixel tests, fixtures must be synthetic, not real private data.

quote: All new Python code must pass `ruff check` and `python -m py_compile`
statement: In Python files, new code must pass `ruff check` and `python -m py_compile`.

quote: Do NOT add unnecessary comments, docstrings, or type annotations to unchanged code
statement: In all code, changes must not add comments, docstrings or type annotations to unchanged code.

quote: Do NOT add error handling, fallbacks, or defensive checks (project follows Let It Crash principle)
statement: In all code, changes must not add error handling, fallbacks or defensive checks.

quote: The project follows Let It Crash — do NOT add try/except blocks
statement: In Python code, changes must not add try/except blocks.

quote: | Installer libraries | `tests/bats-tests/<lib>.bats` | `installers/lib/<lib>.sh` | ... | Scripts | `tests/test-<script>.sh` | `scripts/<script>.sh` |
statement: In ods/tests/, BATS tests for ods/installers/lib/<lib>.sh and phases go in ods/tests/bats-tests/<name>.bats, and tests for ods/scripts/<script>.sh or ods-cli features go in ods/tests/test-<name>.sh.

quote: | API routers | `extensions/services/dashboard-api/tests/test_<router>.py` | `extensions/services/dashboard-api/routers/<router>.py` |
statement: In ods/extensions/services/dashboard-api/tests/, tests for routers/<router>.py go in tests/test_<router>.py (and helpers.py, security.py, gpu.py in test_helpers.py, test_security.py, test_gpu.py).

quote: Python tests: do NOT add `try/except` in tests (Let It Crash principle)
statement: In Python test files, tests must not contain try/except blocks.

quote: DO NOT write tests that: - Test private/internal functions directly (test via public interface)
statement: In test files, tests must not call private/internal functions directly; they must test via the public interface.

quote: - Use `sleep` for synchronization
statement: In test files, tests must not use sleep for synchronization.

quote: - Use `|| true` or silent error suppression
statement: In test files, tests must not use `|| true` or other silent error suppression.

quote: - Depend on test execution order
statement: In test files, tests must not depend on execution order.

quote: - Create test utility frameworks or base classes (KISS)
statement: In test files, code must not create test utility frameworks or test base classes.

quote: - Write parameterized tests for < 3 cases (just write separate tests)
statement: In test files, parameterized tests must not be used for fewer than 3 cases.

quote: Never mock Pydantic validation — let ValidationError propagate per Let It Crash
statement: In Python test files, tests must not mock Pydantic validation; ValidationError must propagate.

quote: ODS CLAUDE.md forbids `2>/dev/null` — never suppress errors in tests
statement: In shell test files, tests must not use `2>/dev/null` to suppress errors.
